Sir!
Attention, all forces. Reggiane's squad and I@will handle the enemies around Rabulpaila's@outer perimeter.
Everyone else, destroy the enemies that have@entered Rabulpaila. Defend the transfer device@with your lives.
Lord Herluga, the Steel Dragons are descending.
Just as planned, they've taken the bait.
The guy on top of the Cross Gate...@Is that Gadisword's big boss, Sieg?
That's the first time I've seen that machine too...
Is Herluga the one piloting it?
Fairy
So it seems. And it's safe to assume that@it has a Siebe Drive installed too.
Its performance is higher than ours...!
These readings swirling around the machine...@It seems to be controlling the energy it absorbs@from the Zemon without letting it run wild.
Its upper limit is on a whole other level from ours.@And with that huge, sturdy frame...@its durability must be high too.
So it can fire off energy weapons@as much as it likes?
Infinitely, in theory.@But only as long as it stays near the Cross Gate.
So if it gets away from that Gate,@it's pointless?
If you put it that way,@the Super Soul Saber right now is...
That large unit and the Zemon Mortar are premised@on linking with the Cross Gate... There must be@all sorts of problems with that, but...
Used well with Rabulpaila's space transfer device,@they could deal heavy damage not just to enemy@bases, but to planet-class targets.
However, they'd struggle against a small elite@force with high mobility, like the Steel Dragons.
And that large unit was built to make up for that...
We'd better assume it can show tremendous@combat power even on its own.
Yeah, since it'd have to meet any army of ruin@coming out of the Cross Gate at the water's edge.
Only a machine worth a thousand@could accomplish that, hm?
Hmph... A worthy opponent.
Yeah, it'll be worth smashing.
Just like the boss lady says.@We'll twist it up easy, like the Ruina's head honcho.
Easy...? We had a really tough time back then.
But Herluga can't be as tough as@<Perfectio> or the <Yotennai>, I bet.
Don't jump to conclusions, Lüne.
Right. There's no guarantee they're our only enemies.
Golaikunru may send in reinforcements.
Aschen
Then we can take them all on at once.@...By we, I mean you lot.
Sister Aschen...
No one's even fazed...?!
Well, we've been through plenty of hell.@But Akemi and Akimi made it this far too.@That's impressive.
Hearing that from you, Lieutenant Ryusei,@gives me confidence.
I see.@No matter what happens, we've got your back.@So don't lose heart, Akimi.
Right!
If only we could seal the Cross Gate@with the Granteed Dracodeus now...!
Shana-Mia
I regret that my power falls short.
No, it's not just your fault, Shana-Mia.@If only I were stronger...
Katia

Tenia
The same goes for me...
Melua

Yeah, I know.
Yes, I understand.
Miles
Attention, all units!@Draw the enemy's main force until the 13th Special@Ops PT Unit destroys the transfer device!
So we're both buying time, huh?
But if we take Herluga down fast, it's settled.
OK, let's have a showdown.
Come, Earthlings.@Before the transfer is ready, I shall@obliterate you with this Floraga.
Herluga...!
Traitor.@I'll send you to the same place as your brother@with my own hands.
The reason you did away with Fio...@It was because he learned a grave secret@about our home planet, wasn't it?!
Haven't you figured it out already?@That our planet no longer exists?
So you admit it...!
Herluga!@How did you find that out?!
Because I saw our home planet's collapse@with my own eyes.
How could that happen...!
It was a hostile force that emerged from the Zemon@that brought catastrophe to our planet. Likely the@same kind of being as this world's <Ruina>.
At first, the leaders of <Anex> hid that fact,@but they were helpless before the enemy's@overwhelming strength...
In the end, they decided to destroy@the Zemon with Rabulpaila.
Wh-What...?!
It was all a disaster Anex brought on itself.@It was we of <Rattma> who discovered the Zemon@under the arctic continent and analyzed it...
But the Anex leadership ordered me@to build Rabulpaila, trying to pull me@away from the Zemon.
And trying to gain its know-how on their own,@they caused that catastrophe.
B-But...!
And so you obeyed the orders@of the Anex leadership?
The crisis left no other choice. Even Malum Quisude@and the others fled to my Rabulpaila,@knowing there was nowhere else to run.
Th-Then...@after that, Rabulpaila didn't head@for the capital, but...
Over the Zemon.@And while fighting fierce battles with the hostile@force, we prepared to fire the Zemon Mortar.
You tried to destroy the Cross Gate@with the Cross Gate's own energy?!
D-Doing something like that would...
No. Our target was not the Zemon itself,@but the core of the hostile force@stationed near it.
You couldn't bear to destroy the Cross Gate,@your object of research, with your own hands?
Exactly. That is the supreme power bestowed@by the gods... Even if Gadisword perishes,@I must hold it in my hands.
That's nothing but your own arrogance!
I am the foremost authority on Zemon research.@Indeed, my work brought Anex victory@in Gadisword's civil war...
and opened the way to securing@<Golaikunru>'s cooperation.
But our planet!
That was not my intention.@The Zemon Mortar's blast annihilated the enemy core,@but an abnormal energy surge arose in the Zemon...
and that caused our home planet's collapse.
So in the end... In the end, it was your fault!
It was the Anex who ordered the Zemon destroyed.@If anything, I tried to keep the damage@to a minimum.
There must have been another way!@After all, the Earthlings drove off the Ruina!
That's hindsight.@I, too, tried to save our planet in that situation...@It merely led to an unfortunate result.
Merely?! You bastard!@How many people do you think died because of that?!
Yes, it is a sad fact.@But it's equally true that Rabulpaila's transfer let@a few Gadisword people, you included, survive.
And in this star system, I encountered the Zemon@once more. That is no mere coincidence.
Then what is it?
A revelation.@The gods have twice granted me the Zemon and@commanded me to forge a new future for Gadisword.
That's just your own selfish delusion!
I was chosen by the Zemon.@And with its power, I shall rule the Zovorg...@no, many star systems.
So that's what you're really after?!
(Is Golaikunru going along with that...?!)
OK, Big Mouth.@You really think you can pull that off@on your own?
It's clear there are multiple Zemon in this universe...@Once I mass-produce my Floraga and Rabulpaila,@using them will make it possible.
...That's quite a long-term plan.
What outrageous boasting.@The fate of those who use the Cross Gate@is already decided.
The prattle of a weakling. You know the Zemon's@power, yet you simply lack the nerve to touch it.
...On Earth, there's a saying:@a wise man keeps away from danger.
(Though only for the time being...)
Now that I've heard what you really want,@there's even less reason to hand over@the Cross Gate!
But you have no way to use the Zemon.
Even if we did, we'd never turn that thing@into a weapon!
Herluga, we're going to crush your schemes!@Right here, right now!!
Don't run your mouth, greenhorn!@I'll hunt down anyone who gets in@Lord Herluga's way!
The Zemon will be your gate to hell!
Seems you don't realize you're the ones@who'll be hunted...!
Even if I must build a mountain of corpses,@my great ambition must be fulfilled...
That alone is a fitting tribute@to our fallen brethren!
You've got no right to say that!@Go to hell and apologize to the dead!

Herluga! We're settling this!
Installing a Siebe Drive... how clever of you.@But even so, you can never defeat@my Floraga.

With Akemi's, Fairy's, and my will as our blade,@we'll cut your ambitions down!

Say what you want!@This is the sword of our souls, Super Soul Saber!@Now feel its power!!
Herluga! We're settling this here and now!
I'll make my will, Akimi's, and Fairy's into a blade@and cut your ambitions down!
Say what you like!@This is the sword of our souls, Super Soul Saber!@Now feel its power!!
I was the one who saved your lives.@To forget that debt and turn on me@deserves a thousand deaths.
Like hell I owe you...!@Why would I feel indebted to the one@who destroyed our planet?!
Your grudge is misplaced.@Our home world fell because of Zemon@and the beings that emerged from it.
And you're trying to do the same@damn thing they did!@Like I'd just stand by and watch!!
Traitors...@You'll meet the same end as the Steel Dragons.
We've had enough tragedies like our planet's!@I'll beat you here and end this war!
The price of using the Cross Gate@goes far beyond anything you imagine.
Hmph. Are you saying it'll cost me my life?
If that were all, it'd be fine.
Hagane: Bridge
Commander, Fairy Cribia has a proposal.
What's that?
She wants to go to Rabulpaila with Sieg Altolied@and Sally Amir and urge the remaining@Gadisword soldiers to surrender.
...That would be more efficient. Very well,@permission granted, under supervision.
Who should go with them?
In case of trouble, someone with strong@combat skills. I'll leave the choice to you.
Roger.
Rabulpaila, Hangar
Gadisword Soldier

That's right! How could we trust them?!
No, you can! After all, the Steel Dragons@took in Sieg, Fairy, and me!
Who'd believe anything a traitor says?!
Then you'd rather trust Herluga...@The one who tried to sell Rabulpaila@out to the Golaikunru?
That woman is our benefactor!@And you dare to...!
Tch, they don't know the first thing...!
...If words won't work, I suppose@we'll have to make them understand by force.
Sis Aschen, that'd defeat the whole purpose.
Yes, let's leave it to them.
Listen up!@Herluga's the one who started the war with Earth!
She dragged Chieftain Malum Quisude off the@stage so she could seize power herself@and join hands with the Golaikunru!
Like we'd believe that either!
Malum
No, it's the truth.
Ch-Chieftain, Your Excellency...!!
Herluga Isbelga held me in confinement.@It was Fairy Cribia who rescued me.
Your Excellency, even if the illness was feigned,@your body has been weakened by captivity.@Please don't push yourself.
But I have unfinished duties.@I must reopen peace talks@with the Earth government...
...and seek a future for the surviving@Gadisword people. Though that will be@no easy task.
Chieftain...
I will take responsibility for persuading our@brethren on Rabulpaila to lay down their arms.
Fairy, return to the Steel Dragons@and inform Commander Miles of this.
...Understood.
Captain, Lieutenant Lamia and the others@are back from Rabulpaila.
Also, the 13th Special Operations PT Unit@will be returning to the Cross Gate Watch Fleet.
We owe this victory to their efforts...
That's true, but the fighting@isn't all over yet.@I'm concerned about the Golaikunru's moves.
The Captain is right.@We've secured what they were after.@If they make their move now...
Don't tell me, the Golaikunru?!

Wh-What is that?!
Oh no!@They're going to fire the Orgo-La Tedrable@Cannon on the bow!
Everyone, get out of the line of fire! Hurry!!
